# Echo AI Toolkit — LLM Context Bundle

Paste this file as context when using GPT-4o, Gemini, local models, or any LLM that doesn't
load the full repo. It is a compressed single-file reference for the Echo Universal API.

Source: https://github.com/NetVar1337/echo-ai-toolkit
Full API: https://echo-23.gitbook.io/angel/llms-full.txt

---

## What is Echo?

Echo is an external scripting platform for Windows games. Scripts are written in AngelScript
and run outside the game process. Echo provides:
- External process memory read (no injection, no writes)
- Discord overlay rendering (renderer namespace)
- Zydis disassembler (proc.disasm_range)
- Unicorn CPU emulator (emulator@)
- JSON, HTTP, WebSocket, file I/O
- Menu system with config persistence

Scripts are placed in `%AppData%\Roaming\scripts\`. No compile step — reload from the in-game menu.

---

## AngelScript type rules (get these wrong → script crash)

- Addresses are ALWAYS `uint64`. Never `uint32` — it silently truncates 64-bit pointers.
- Null check: `if (ptr is null)` NOT `if (ptr == null)`
- Array length: `arr.length()` NOT `arr.size()`
- Float literals MUST have `f` suffix: `1.5f` not `1.5`
- No try/catch — check return values; `proc.read` returns 0 on failure
- No `auto` keyword — always explicit type: `uint64 x = proc.read<uint64>(addr);`
- String format: `fmt("val: {}", x)` not `"val: " + x`
- `nullptr` → `null`

---

## Script structure

```angelscript
void main() {
    proc.attach("game.exe");
    if (!proc.is_running()) return;
    // scan patterns once here
    create_thread(64, function() {
        while (proc.is_running()) { tick(); sleep(1); }
    });
}
void on_unload() { proc.detach(); }
void on_render() { /* draw calls here — runs every frame */ }
```

---

## Process / memory namespace

```
proc.attach(name)                        → void
proc.detach()                            → void
proc.is_running()                        → bool
proc.read<T>(addr)                       → T  (T: uint8/16/32/64, float, double, bool, vec2/3/4)
proc.write<T>(addr, val)                 → void  ⚠ triggers AC on kernel-protected games
proc.scan_ida(pattern, module)           → uint64  (0 on fail)
proc.resolve_rip(instr_addr, op_off, instr_len) → uint64  (resolves RIP-relative LEA/MOV)
proc.get_module(name)                    → module_info@  (null if not found)
proc.get_modules()                       → array<module_info>
proc.disasm_range(addr, size)            → array<instruction>
proc.query_regions()                     → array<region_info>
```

module_info fields: `.base`, `.size`, `.name`

---

## Renderer namespace (call only inside on_render)

```
renderer.draw_rect_filled(x,y,w,h, col)
renderer.draw_rect_outlined(x,y,w,h, thick, col)
renderer.draw_rect_gradient(x,y,w,h, tl,tr,bl,br)
renderer.draw_line(x1,y1, x2,y2, col, thick)
renderer.draw_circle(cx,cy,r, segs, col, thick)
renderer.draw_circle_filled(cx,cy,r, segs, col)
renderer.text(x,y, text, col, font)
renderer.text_outlined(x,y, text, col, outline_col, font)
renderer.measure_text(text, font)        → vec2
renderer.load_font(family, size, bold)   → font_handle@
renderer.width()                         → uint
renderer.height()                        → uint
```

`color_t(r,g,b,a)` — all 0–255.

---

## W2S built-ins (world-to-screen)

```
source2.w2s(proc, vm_addr, world_pos, sx, sy)  → bool  (CS2, Deadlock)
unreal.w2s(proc, vm_addr, world_pos, sx, sy)   → bool  (UE4/UE5)
unity.w2s(proc, vm_addr, world_pos, sx, sy)    → bool  (Unity)
source.w2s(proc, vm_addr, world_pos, sx, sy)   → bool  (CS:GO, TF2)
```

Always check the bool return — returns false when point is behind camera.

---

## Input namespace

```
input.key_down(vk)       → bool   (held)
input.key_pressed(vk)    → bool   (one frame)
mouse.move(dx, dy)       → void
mouse.move_to(x, y)      → void
mouse.click(btn)         → void   (0=left,1=right,2=middle)
input.mouse_pos()        → vec2
```

Common VK codes: VK_INSERT=0x2D, VK_DELETE=0x2E, VK_HOME=0x24, VK_F1–F12=0x70–0x7B

---

## Menu namespace

```angelscript
menu_checkbox@ cb = menu.checkbox("Enable", false);
menu_slider_float@ sl = menu.slider_float("Smooth", 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.08f);
menu_color_picker@ cp = menu.color_picker("Color", color_t(255,0,0,200));
menu_combo@ co = menu.combo("Mode", {"Off","Low","High"}, 0);
menu_button@ bt = menu.button("Reset");
menu_input_text@ it = menu.input_text("Name", "default");
menu_keybind@ kb = menu.keybind("Aim key", 0x02);

bool on      = cb.get();
float val    = sl.get();
color_t col  = cp.get();
int idx      = co.get();
bool clicked = bt.get();
string text  = it.get();
int vk       = kb.get();

menu.save_config("mymod");
menu.load_config("mymod");
```

## Math helpers

```
math.rad_to_deg(r)   math.deg_to_rad(d)
math.lerp(a,b,t)     math.clamp(v,lo,hi)
math.abs(v)          math.sqrt(v)
math.sin(r)  math.cos(r)  math.atan2(y,x)
math.normalize_angle(a)   // wraps to [-180,180]
math.calc_fov(src, tgt, view_angles) → float
```

vec3: `.length()`, `.normalized()`, `.dot(b)`, `.cross(b)`, `+`, `-`, `* float`

---

## Threading

```angelscript
create_thread(tps, callback)   // tps=0 = unlimited — always use >=1
sleep(ms)
mutex@ mtx = mutex();
mtx.lock();  mtx.unlock();
mtx.lock_shared();  mtx.unlock_shared();
```

Build into local tmp array, swap under mutex — never resize shared array mid-render.

---

## Unicorn emulator

```angelscript
emulator@ emu = emulator.create(UC_ARCH_X86, UC_MODE_64);
emu.mem_map(addr, size, UC_PROT_ALL);
emu.mem_write(addr, bytes);
emu.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_RAX, val);
emu.emu_start(start_addr, end_addr, timeout_us, max_insn);
uint64 result = emu.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_RAX);
```

UC_PROT_NONE=0, READ=1, WRITE=2, EXEC=4, ALL=7

---

## Common patterns

**Scan + RIP resolve:**
```angelscript
uint64 instr = proc.scan_ida("48 8B 05 ? ? ? ?", "client.dll");
if (instr == 0) { alert("pattern failed"); return; }
uint64 ptr = proc.resolve_rip(instr, 3, 7);
uint64 list = proc.read<uint64>(ptr);
```

**FTransform bone read (UE4/UE5 — stride is 48 bytes):**
```angelscript
uint64 entry = bone_base + uint64(idx) * 48;
float bx = proc.read<float>(entry + 16);  // translation.x
float by = proc.read<float>(entry + 20);
float bz = proc.read<float>(entry + 24);
```

**Cornered box:**
```angelscript
void draw_cornered_box(float x,float y,float w,float h, color_t col) {
    float c = w*0.22f; float t = 1.5f;
    renderer.draw_line(x,y, x+c,y, col,t);    renderer.draw_line(x,y, x,y+c, col,t);
    renderer.draw_line(x+w,y, x+w-c,y, col,t); renderer.draw_line(x+w,y, x+w,y+c, col,t);
    renderer.draw_line(x,y+h, x+c,y+h, col,t); renderer.draw_line(x,y+h, x,y+h-c, col,t);
    renderer.draw_line(x+w,y+h, x+w-c,y+h, col,t); renderer.draw_line(x+w,y+h, x+w,y+h-c, col,t);
}
```

---

## Top crash causes

1. `uint32` for addresses — use `uint64`
2. No null check after pointer read — `if (ptr == 0) continue;`
3. No null check after pattern scan — `if (addr == 0) return;`
4. `arr.size()` → `arr.length()`
5. `if (h == null)` → `if (h is null)`
6. FTransform stride 16 instead of 48
7. `proc.read` before `proc.attach`
8. Pattern scan inside the tick loop (scan once in main)

## Templates in this repo

| File | What it shows |
|------|--------------|
| `templates/basic.as` | Minimal main + on_unload |
| `templates/render.as` | ESP box + color picker |
| `templates/menu.as` | All menu element types |
| `templates/memory.as` | Attach + scan + RIP resolve + tick loop |
| `templates/esp-bones.as` | Full CS2 ESP: box, skeleton, health bar |
| `templates/aimbot.as` | CS2 aimbot: FOV, smooth, predict, recoil |
| `templates/ue5-sdk.as` | UE5 GWorld traversal from Dumper-7 SDK |
| `templates/unity-il2cpp.as` | Unity IL2CPP ESP |
| `templates/valorant.as` | Valorant ESP (VGK external) |
| `templates/fortnite.as` | Fortnite ESP (UE5/EAC) |

---

## Anti-cheat surface

Echo is external and read-only by design:
- Never `proc.write` to game memory on EAC/BattlEye/Vanguard targets
- Never jump cursor directly to target — use smooth lerp per tick
- Use `create_thread(64, ...)` not `create_thread(0, ...)`
- Add `sleep(uint(random.int(0, 4)))` in aim loop for timing variance
